remarks: Beautiful, Newly Painted 2-Family Home in the Desirable Cove Neighborhood. Second Floor - $2,950/month Features 3 bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, living room, and a kitchen with pantry. Primary bedroom includes a walk-in closet. Laundry is conveniently located beside the staircase. Includes 2 reserved parking spaces in the backyard.    The owner prefers to rent the entire property to one family for $6,545/month.  Alternatively: First Floor + Basement - $3,595/month Includes a kitchen, 3 bedrooms, 1 full bathroom, and a living room. The basement offers laundry hookups and three tiled storage rooms. Includes 2 reserved parking spaces in the backyard.  Additional features include a spacious, newly paved parking lot.  Front garage/storage shed available for $400/month, and rear shed for $350/month. The owner prefers to rent the Storage Shed to the tenant of the unit. Tenants renting the entire house will receive a discount on storage sheds.  Located in the highly desirable Cove neighborhood, on the Stamford/Darien border. Convenient access to I-95, Chelsea Piers Stamford, and public transportation. Walk to beautiful Cove Island Park   Move-in ready - available immediately! Don't miss this opportunity!
